title: Ghost Network Watch - index availability special cases: hard-dead and User-Agent-gated CMS machine-readable index URLs
method: Each URL fetched twice on 2026-08-21 with a 512-byte Range GET: once with curl's default User-Agent, once with a browser User-Agent (Chrome 126 on macOS). Follow-ups (full index fetch, redirect trace) noted per case.
framing_note: Statements describe observed HTTP behavior of the URL each issuer submitted to CMS in the PY2026 Machine-Readable URL PUF.

cases.status_2026_08_21: STILL DEAD - HTTP 404 with browser UA (406 with default UA)
cases.detail: The URL submitted to CMS returns a 404 HTML error page (60,585 bytes) to a browser UA and 406 to curl's default UA. No machine-readable index is retrievable at the issuer's submitted URL. Matches the original probe finding.

cases.status_2026_08_21: RECOVERED - now serves valid CMS index JSON (was DNS-dead at original probe)
cases.detail: DNS now resolves and the URL returns HTTP 200/206 application/json with both UAs. Full fetch on 2026-08-21 parsed as valid JSON conforming to the CMS index schema, listing PROVIDERS-2026.json plus 27 provpharmacy-*-2026.json files. Status change since the original probe; the deep-probe stats for this index need to be redone.

cases.status_2026_08_21: UA-GATED - 403 to default UA, 206 application/json to browser UA (confirmed)
cases.detail: One shared index URL covering 20 UnitedHealthcare issuer rows across 19 states (TX has two issuer IDs). 403 (919-byte HTML block page) for curl default UA; 206 application/json with browser UA. Programmatic/aggregator access without browser headers is blocked.

cases.status_2026_08_21: UA-GATED - 403 to default UA, 206 application/json to browser UA (confirmed)
cases.detail: CloudFront/S3 origin returns 403 application/xml to curl default UA; 206 application/json with browser UA.

cases.status_2026_08_21: UA-GATED - 403 to default UA, 206 application/json to browser UA (confirmed); also appears in staleness exhibit
cases.detail: Same gating as WHPI. Note: this index is also stale exhibit rank 4 - provider file records last attested 2025-09-15; file Last-Modified 2026-06-12.

cases.status_2026_08_21: UA-GATED + REDIRECT - 403 to default UA; browser UA gets 301 to lowercase path then 200 application/json
cases.detail: Default UA: 403. Browser UA: 301 to https://www.mercycarehealthplans.com/wp-content/uploads/json/cms-data-index/ (lowercase 'json', trailing slash), which returns 200 application/json. Crawlers must follow redirects and use a browser UA.
